beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The Ultimate Sense of Life asks why cosmic answers must matter to ordinary lives.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Its serious comedy brings religions, laboratories, philosophers, and working people into one argument.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The opening wager is that life makes existence capable of caring about existence.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Then the book asks whether that care survives contact with actual obligations.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The book imagines humanity complaining that existence arrived without a user manual.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Cosmic support offers another restart, although previous attempts caused severe data loss.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Behind the joke lies a distinction between cosmic purpose and lived meaning.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Psychology can study how life feels meaningful without proving a universal intention.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: That distinction lets the book compare religious and philosophical answers without collapsing them.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The roof repairer needs no theory explaining why the cosmos intended timber.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: A storm approaches, someone needs shelter, and skilled work can make a difference.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The proposed FIRE model names four parts of such lived meaning.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Finitude gives time stakes, while integration connects action with commitments we understand.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Relation concerns who or what matters, while enactment turns that value into practice.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: FIRE is a philosophical synthesis and research proposal, not an established psychological scale.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: But feeling purposeful does not automatically make an action good.
